scope: Compare the stopped attempt03 snapshot with the original Anvil state file after the old service resumed. This is a filesystem diagnostic, not a clone, migration, cutover, chain replay, financial acceptance or rollout approval.

execution.transport: Existing SSH identity with BatchMode=yes and StrictHostKeyChecking=yes; Python helper supplied on stdin
execution.output: Only sizes, hashes, bounded shape/count metadata and classification booleans. No account-state values, raw blocks, transaction bodies, receipts, traces or logs are retained.

inputs.backupSelection: The original attempt03 state.json backup path, required to remain inside that attempt directory
inputs.fileBoundary: Regular single-link files, at most32MiB each, with device/inode/size/mtime checked unchanged across each read
inputs.topLevelBoundary: Exact six-field set: accounts, best_block_number, block, blocks, historical_states, transactions. Unknown or absent top-level fields reject comparison.

completeUnchangedFields: accounts, including all nested account data
block, including all nine original fields

transactions.coverage: Each complete JSON transaction object, including its receipt, traces, logs and every other field; no selected-field projection. Only array order differs.

blocks.coverage: Duplicate-preserving multisets of complete block JSON objects, with all headers and non-header fields retained.

extraBlock.classification: An additional empty default-genesis record, consistent with the intervening Anvil restart; no execution trace of startup was collected.
extraBlock.timestampExclusionPurpose: Diagnostic comparison only. The complete original block hashes and the extra full block hash remain retained; no block or timestamp is discarded from acceptance authority.

decision.reason: This is not solely serialization order: one complete historical block record was added. Matching account/head/transaction data does not make the full persisted state identical.
decision.recommendedOperation: Take a fresh stopped snapshot; validate the complete new and old clone against that snapshot while the original chain/controller stay stopped; compare the complete raw fingerprint again before activation; do not resume the old chain between snapshot and activation.
decision.operationStatus: The parent approved redesign around a fresh held stopped snapshot. This report does not claim that redesigned operation has run or passed.

evidence.description: Exact retained final safe comparison helper, read-only and stdout-only; it performs no equivalence authorization.
Complete safe stdout from re-executing the retained helper against the fixed attempt03 snapshot and current state. UTF-8/LF JSON retains all emitted fields.

limits: The multiset comparison uses SHA-256 of complete canonical JSON values and preserves duplicate counts; it does not verify Ethereum execution or consensus.
Per-file stability checks do not make separate filesystem reads a globally atomic chain snapshot. Reuse requires a new original stopped-state boundary.
The helper is fixed to attempt03 and is diagnostic only, not a general migration or cutover verifier.
No original data was restored or overwritten, no production source/configuration changed, and no rollout, M6/M7 or functional-percentage credit is awarded.
